class.name: JarCraterSdf
class.brief_description: Impact craters on top of another SDF, such as a moon's [JarTerrainSdf].
class.description: Adds bowl-shaped craters with raised rims to [member JarModifierSdf.sdf], in several sizes: each octave halves the radius and has four times as many craters. Craters are measured along the child's surface, using its up field (a planet's center, or +Y for flat terrain), and applied as a height change, so they follow the terrain underneath and need no extra samples of the child. Volumes in [constant JarVoxelVolume.UP_MODE_AUTO] still see the child's up field and sea level.

members.member: Chance that a cell holds a crater. Each octave has one cell per four crater radii.
Depth of a crater bowl as a fraction of its radius.
Number of crater sizes, from [member size] down, halving each time.
Height of a crater rim as a fraction of its radius.
Radius in meters of the largest craters (radii vary per crater between half and all of this).
